title: Act: Mount admin round routes and expose the scheduler
summary: Wire round.Service into server.New and start the scheduler in main
description: In server.New build round.FileStore, round.Service and admin.RoundHandler and mount five round routes under the admin group. Expose a NewScheduler builder and start it from main.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler runs in main with cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval
technical_constraints: Use existing gitCLI and contribution store

steps.action: Before r.Route("/api/v1/admin"...), build rs := &round.Service{Store:&round.FileStore{Root:cfg.Storage.RepoPath}, Committer:gitCLI, Revisions:gitCLI, Contributions:store} and rh := &admin.RoundHandler{Rounds:&roundAdmin{Svc:rs}, Lister:store}. Inside the admin group add ar.Post("/rounds", rh.Create), ar.Post("/rounds/{id}/open", rh.Open), ar.Post("/rounds/{id}/close", rh.Close), ar.Get("/rounds/{id}", rh.Get), ar.Get("/rounds/{id}/contributions", rh.Contributions). Import internal/round.
steps.expected: The five round routes no longer return 404

steps.action: Add func NewScheduler(cfg *config.Config) *round.Scheduler returning &round.Scheduler{Controller: the round.Service built from cfg, Rounds: the round.FileStore, Worlds: func() ([]string, error) listing IDs from world.Repo.List, Interval: cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval}. Extract the round.Service construction into helper newRoundService(cfg) used by both New and NewScheduler.
steps.expected: NewScheduler returns a scheduler with the configured interval

steps.action: Before http.ListenAndServe, create ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM); defer stop(); then go server.NewScheduler(cfg).Run(ctx).
